single.rationale: NBIX demonstrates exceptional execution with consistent 20%+ revenue growth, expanding operating margins (now 21.6%), and strong cash generation (FCF margin 26.2%). The company has two established commercial products with INGREZZA growing solidly and CRENESSITY delivering $301M in its first full year, plus a robust late-stage pipeline targeting large psychiatric markets (MDD, schizophrenia) with Phase 3 readouts expected in 2027 that could significantly expand the addressable market.

team.thesis: Neurocrine demonstrates exceptional financial performance with 21.4% revenue growth to $2.9B and a 26.2% free cash flow margin ($748.7M FCF), but faces critical concentration risk as INGREZZA represents $2.51B of total sales while the pipeline's two key late-stage candidates (osavampator and direclidine) both carry binary outcome risk with Phase 3 data not expected until 2027.
